name: Dockers CI Container Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/**
    tags:
      - v*
    paths:
      - 'dockers/**'
      - '.github/workflows/dockers-*'
      - 'hack/docker/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'dockers/**'
      - '.github/workflows/dockers-*'
      - 'hack/docker/**'

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata for dev container
        id: meta-dev
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/vald-dev-container
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=tag
            type=sha

      - name: Build and push dev container
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: dockers/dev/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta-dev.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta-dev.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Verify container image
        run: |
          docker run --rm ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/vald-dev-container cat /etc/os-release | grep -i "debian\|ubuntu"
          docker run --rm ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/vald-dev-container which pigz

  lint-yaml:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup yamlfmt
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y yamlfmt

      - name: Format YAML files
        run: |
          find .github/workflows -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamlfmt -w
          git diff --exit-code

  validate-dockerfiles:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run hadolint
        uses: hadolint/hadolint-action@v3.1.0
        with:
          dockerfile: dockers/dev/Dockerfile
          threshold: error

  test-dockerfile:
    needs: [build-and-push]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download dev container image
        uses: ishworkh/container-image-artifact-download@v2.1.0
        with:
          image: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/vald-dev-container
          workflow: dockers-ci-container-image.yaml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Test container functionality
        run: |
          docker run --rm ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/vald-dev-container echo "Container is working correctly"
          docker run --rm ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/vald-dev-container pigz --version
